---
title: "Team"
---

<!-- The team list lives in `team.csv`. To add or change a person, edit that file in -->
<!-- RStudio and re-render; the tables below update automatically. -->

```{r}
#| label: load-team
#| echo: false
team <- read.csv("team.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
show_people <- function(x) {
  knitr::kable(
    x[, c("name", "role", "institute")],
    col.names = c("Name", "Role", "Institute"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

## Project team

```{r}
#| echo: false
show_people(team[team$group != "Consortium", ])
```

## Consortium members

```{r}
#| echo: false
show_people(team[team$group == "Consortium", ])
```
